brief.note: Endeavour Silver joins on a three-week mill repair; Fluence is on its last day in the window.

candidates.name: Endeavour Silver Corp.
candidates.business: Mines silver and gold in Mexico, Peru and Chile
candidates.cause: Took the main ball mill at its Guanacevi mine offline on 21 September for a three-week trunnion replacement, cutting throughput from 1,100 to 600 tonnes daily.
candidates.right: The mill repair finishes on schedule and Guanacevi throughput returns by mid-October
candidates.wrong: The trunnion damage proves deeper, the outage drags on and guidance is cut

candidates.name: Fluence Energy, Inc.
candidates.business: Builds grid-scale battery storage systems and sells optimisation software for renewables
candidates.cause: Cut full-year revenue guidance to about $2.4bn from $3bn and now expects a $200m adjusted EBITDA loss, blaming supply chain and Houston ramp problems.
candidates.right: The Houston ramp and supply chain must resolve before the cash burn forces a raise
candidates.wrong: Liquidity tightens as losses widen and the retreat from US business becomes permanent
